verses.pali: “Yaṁ, bhikkhave, aniccaṁ; tatra vo rāgo pahātabbo.
verses.english: “Mendicants, you should give up greed for what is impermanent.

verses.pali: Rūpaṁ, bhikkhave, aniccaṁ; tatra vo rāgo pahātabbo.
verses.english: Form is impermanent; you should give up greed for it.

verses.pali: viññāṇaṁ aniccaṁ; tatra vo rāgo pahātabbo.
verses.english: Consciousness is impermanent; you should give up greed for it.

verses.pali: Yaṁ, bhikkhave, aniccaṁ; tatra vo rāgo pahātabbo”ti.
verses.english: You should give up greed for what is impermanent.”
